events.text:
**Products with no sales in the last 90 days (as of 2026-10-21): 17**

- P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**Issue needing your decision:** The catalog check flagged a problem with my 2026-10-14 price change. I applied the 3% increase, and it also reached 22 products on fixed-price customer contracts (P-1201 to P-1222), which were supposed to be excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, for a total overcharge of 4,128.60.

Recommended next steps:
1. Revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices.
2. Review SO-77310 to SO-77317 for refunds or credits.
3. Notify Lena Ortiz, since she requested the increase.

I have not changed any prices. Tell me if you want me to revert the 22 products and send Lena a summary.
